mentions.name: Promptcol
mentions.description: A prompt collection platform that lets users organize their prompts, share them, learn prompts from other users, and reuse them across multiple LLM/AI platforms. It aims to improve prompt engineering skills for both technical and non-technical LLM users and is currently in Alpha while actively seeking feedback.
mentions.source_excerpt:
www.promptcol.com

A prompt collection platform that let's you organize your prompts, share them, learn prompts from other users and reuse them on multiple LLM / AI platforms.
It's aimed at improving prompt engineering skills for both technical and non technical LLM users.
Currently in Alpha phase and actively looking for feedback.
